question: For each port status, list the port status, an IP-allocation category ('Has IP Allocation' if the status has any ports with an IP allocation, 'No IP Allocation' otherwise), and the variance of the standard attribute ID across ports that have an IP allocation. Include subtotals per port status and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    p.status AS port_status,
    CASE WHEN ia.port_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_ip_alloc,
    CASE WHEN ia.port_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.standard_attr_id END AS std_attr_if_ip
  FROM ports p
  LEFT JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id
)
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE port_status END AS port_status,
  CASE 
    WHEN GROUPING(port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL'
    WHEN MAX(has_ip_alloc) = 1 THEN 'Has IP Allocation'
    ELSE 'No IP Allocation'
  END AS ip_allocation_category,
  VARIANCE(std_attr_if_ip) AS standard_attr_id_variance
FROM base
GROUP BY port_status
WITH ROLLUP
